name: 第一代半自动化 Memory 芯片测试分选机

evidence.excerpt: 序号 5；研发课题/项目：Memory 芯片分选机研发；技术储备：第一代半自动化覆盖 32 工位至 128 工位的 Memory 芯片测试分选机已实现小批量出货

notes: The issuer's first memory handler. FY2025 annual report p14 said only that it was watching demand for a Memory platform, so this is the first shipment claim the atlas holds. Semi-automatic, 32 to 128 sites at most (reply p38 prints 半自动化运行；最大支持工位 128 工位). No model name, customer, memory type or unit count. Says nothing of DRAM, HBM, known-good-die or stack test. A handler, not a memory tester. Revenue cannot be separated from 其他设备. The name is descriptive, built from the row wording, so no alias is claimed.
